description: RbNa₂B₆O₁₀Cl crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Rb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.40 Å. There is one shorter (3.23 Å) and one longer (3.28 Å) Rb-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.89 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.66 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.79 Å. There are six inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond length. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.54 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. In the sixth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. Cl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb and two Na atoms.
